reproduction.method: Huber IRLS and logistic Newton MLE/L2-MAP
reproduction.description: Demonstrates two original optimization applications using actual fitted objectives, robust residual scores and regularization-induced slope shrinkage.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
Bounded subset only: Huber regression and binary logistic MLE/MAP; minFunc is replaced by IRLS and explicit Newton.
Synthetic 100-case regression adds an intercept and controlled outliers; 180-case logistic data is nonseparable so a finite MLE exists.
Omits probit, kernel/multinomial models, neural networks, smooth SVM/SVR and graphical-model examples. Penalties use average loss and leave the bias unpenalized.
